title: quercus ilex var. ballota
intro: Quercus ilex var. ballota, commonly known as the Ballota oak or Bitter oak, is a variant of the holm oak tree (Quercus ilex) native to the Mediterranean region. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiviral properties, which can help to alleviate digestive issues, reduce fever, and soothe respiratory problems. The therapeutic actions of Quercus ilex var. ballota include expectorant, anti-inflammatory, and antispasmodic actions, which can help to relieve coughs, reduce pain and swelling, and calm muscle spasms. The bioactive constituents of this plant include tannins, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
